note: This file is a configuration-only file (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines dataset settings, preprocessing pipelines, dataloaders, and evaluators for LVIS v0.5 instance detection in MMDetection.
review_dataset_config: review the LVIS v0.5 instance detection dataset configuration including train and test pipelines
summarize_train_pipeline: summarize the training data augmentation pipeline with random resize and flip operations
summarize_test_pipeline: summarize the test pipeline that loads images, resizes, and packs detection inputs
review_dataloader_config: review the train and validation dataloader settings including batch size and aspect ratio sampling
review_evaluator_config: review the LVIS metric evaluator configuration for bbox and segmentation metrics
